content.text: : mental stress, sleep deprivation, eye strain
pericranial muscle tenderness common (head, neck, shoulders)
focal neurologic SXS that usually last <60min
, accompany or follow the HA within 60min
, aspirin first line if mild; some meds have caffeine to improve sxs
IV fluids, placing patient in dark/quiet room
if mod-severe or no response to analgesics
Associated w/ multiple frequent HAs w/ high intensity & brief duration
worse at night, ETOH, stress, specific foods
spontaneous remission & occur several times a day
may have 1-2 cluster periods a year
